title: Parity DNF represents parity
statement: For every natural number $n$, the Boolean function represented by the minterm DNF of parity on all $n$ coordinates equals parity on all $n$ coordinates; explicitly, its value at $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ is $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}x_i$.
